subject: Using LuaJIT/Terra to get JIT compiled code on the Hadoop Noes

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Using LuaJIT/Terra to get JIT compiled code on the Hadoop Noes
parts:
Hello,

rterra is a package that uses TerraLanguage to write extensions in Lua which is run through LuaJIT. Also one can write Terra functions which are compiled to machine code via LLVM. It is a self contained R package.

One achieves extremely fast performance because of luaJit and deterministic fast performance via Clang compilation.

I've written a blog post that outlines how one can use rterra in Hadoop.

http://people.mozilla.org/~sguha/blog/2014/02/24/using-terra-llvm-in-hadoop.html

Cheers
Saptarshi
